title: Harmful YouTube Video Detection: A Taxonomy of Online Harm and MLLMs as Alternative Annotators
abstract: arXiv:2411.05854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video platforms, used by billions globally, are criticized for exposing users to harmful content. Yet, detecting online harm remains challenging due to inconsistent approaches to what constitutes harm and limitations of human annotation. We address both challenges. Theoretically, we integrate and expand existing taxonomies and platform guidelines to multimodal contexts and develop a comprehensive taxonomy for online harm. We categorize online harm on video platforms into six content-based categories: Information, Hate and harassment, Addictive, Clickbait, Sexual, and Physical harms. Methodologically, we propose and systematically test multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as alternative annotators of harmful videos. We curate a dataset of 19,422 potentially harmful YouTube videos and annotate them using GPT-4-Turbo, non-trained crowdworkers, and trained annotators. translated_title: 有害YouTube视频检测：网络危害分类体系与多模态大语言模型作为替代标注者
translated_abstract: 全球数十亿人使用的视频平台因让用户接触有害内容而受到批评。然而，由于对“何为危害”的界定方法不一致以及人工标注的局限性，检测网络危害仍然具有挑战性。我们针对这两个挑战提出了解决方案。在理论层面，我们整合并扩展现有的分类体系和平台准则，将其拓展至多模态场景，构建了一个全面的网络危害分类体系。我们将视频平台上的网络危害归纳为六种基于内容的类别：信息危害、仇恨与骚扰、成瘾性危害、标题党、性危害和人身伤害。在方法层面，我们提出并系统地测试了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）作为有害视频的替代标注者。我们整理了一个包含19,422个潜在有害YouTube视频的数据集，并使用GPT-4-Turbo、未经训练的众包工作者和经过训练的标注者对其进行标注。我们讨论了多模态大语言模型在平台内容审核中的潜在应用。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个涵盖信息、仇恨与骚扰、成瘾性、标题党、性和人身伤害六大类别的网络视频危害综合分类体系，并系统验证了以GPT-4-Turbo为代表的多模态大语言模型可以作为人工标注的有效替代方案来检测有害YouTube视频。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a comprehensive six-category taxonomy of online harm on video platforms and systematically demonstrates that multimodal large language models (e.g., GPT-4-Turbo) can serve as effective alternative annotators to humans for detecting harmful YouTube videos.
